rawFindings.title: Invalid current page fallback value leading to incorrect pagination
rawFindings.explanation: The code changes the fallback for current page from this.current to this.page.current, which may not be defined, causing current to be undefined or 0 and breaking pagination logic.
rawFindings.suggestion: Ensure that this.page and this.page.current exist before fallback, or keep fallback to this.current if safer.

rawFindings.title: No return for current=0 leads to empty pagination
rawFindings.explanation: Addition of 'if (!current) return ''' means that if current is 0 or falsy, pagination returns empty string silently. This might break existing behavior if current page can be 0 or undefined intentionally.
rawFindings.suggestion: Confirm that current=0 is invalid state and handle appropriately or document behavior clearly.
